response_equation: N_intensifier(lambda,row)=sum_s gamma_s(lambda)[photons/(neutral s)]*C_s(lambda,row)[neutral s]*T_owned(lambda); gamma and T are not yet supplied
factor_ownership: K contains isotropic1/(4pi),dxdy and accepted z integration and pupil/slit/speccone geometry once. No extra volume, depth, etendue or4pi. Spectral profiles/bin fractions and measured wavelength losses remain separate.
source_limit: Historical independent assumed neutral pools used only for density-weighted unit-rate coefficients; not a common-water-monolayer CR source or inferred emissivity.
edge_definition: Geometric current-position regions: outer0.5mm of each width side plus exterior; center|x|<=0.5mm; remaining interior separate. These are not packet origin labels.
time_interpolation: Exact gate integration of declared piecewise-linear saved-density interpolant; no population extrapolation.
detector_plane_status: conditional slit-image spatial coordinate, magnification1; bins are not historical CMOS pixels

scenarios.assumptions: Finalleg5/8/11inches is a scenario consistent with a folded path, not human-confirmed. Effective equal focal lengths are derived from B=0 at foil-width center, not identified mirror specifications.

kernel_diagnostics.magnification_interpretation: ABCD A is image magnification only at B=0; otherwise it is a transfer coefficient
kernel_diagnostics.foil_occlusion_model: open rectangular x/y interior, invariant z
kernel_diagnostics.source_cell_geometry: cell-center x/y; exact stated z integral
kernel_diagnostics.detector_coordinate_reference: slit image coordinate times authored detector_magnification; no recovered iCMOS pixel mapping
limitations: Unfolded positive thin elements; paraxial slopes with exact first-pupil solid-angle measure.
No off-axis mirror astigmatism, diffraction, aberration or measured line-spread function.
Unspecified window clear aperture and camera active-area clipping are not modeled.
No calibrated mirror/window/grating/detector spectral transmission is inserted.
Source density requires a separately supplied CR photon-emission rate.
